claim: When FSx for Lustre is an input data source for Amazon SageMaker, SageMaker jobs start as soon as the file system is linked with the S3 bucket, and data is lazy loaded as needed from Amazon S3 for processing jobs.

evidence.quote: Data is lazy loaded as needed from Amazon S3 for processing jobs.
SageMaker jobs are started as soon as the FSx for Lustre file system is linked with the S3 bucket without needing to download the full machine learning training dataset from S3.
